##### Project general facts

Bayz 101 is a landmark residential tower by Danube Properties, strategically positioned in the prestigious Business Bay district. Rising prominently above the surrounding skyline, the development offers panoramic views of some of Dubai’s most recognizable landmarks, including Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Canal, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jumeirah, and the coastline. Designed to provide a sophisticated urban lifestyle, the tower combines contemporary architecture with a prime central location, placing residents within easy reach of the city's major business, leisure, and entertainment destinations.

The development offers a lifestyle centered on convenience, connectivity, and comfort. Located just a short walk from the Business Bay Metro Station and close to Sheikh Zayed Road, Bayz 101 provides excellent accessibility throughout Dubai. Residents benefit from a range of premium amenities designed to enhance daily living, creating an environment that balances relaxation, wellness, and social interaction. The tower’s elevated position and carefully planned facilities contribute to an exclusive residential experience in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

The interiors feature premium finishing with high-quality materials that reflect the project's upscale character. Each apartment is delivered fully furnished, offering a turnkey living solution with stylish and functional living spaces. The residences also include equipped kitchens with appliances, ensuring convenience and practicality from day one. The combination of elegant furnishings, quality finishes, and thoughtfully designed layouts creates a contemporary living environment tailored to modern urban lifestyles.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
